purpose: Reference values for the P05 TypeScript port of the P03 statistics: recompute Sen's slope, original Mann-Kendall p-value and tau from values and compare. Series are synthetic test data, not NASA results.

conventions.sen_slope: median pairwise slope at real time positions (year-1)
conventions.p_value_original: unmodified Mann-Kendall test on the values as given
conventions.mk_tau: Kendall tau of the unmodified Mann-Kendall test

hamed_rao.source: pymannkendall.hamed_rao_modification_test (alpha 0.05, lag None); NaN skipped; synthetic series
